# Demo cards

An invented person, Nour, who runs a small bakery, teaches a baking class and plays the oud.
Nothing here describes a real person or business. The cards are written in the two layouts
that turn up in practice: one item per bullet, and everything on the heading's own line.

This line mentions a PROJECT CARD in passing and must not start one.

## Area: Bakery

### PROJECT CARD 1
name: Dar Bakery order book
one_line: A notebook app where the bakery writes every order, who it is for and when it is due.
area: Bakery
kind: running product
last_activity: 2026-11-10 (app); 2026-10-02 (printed forms)
source: phone app and a paper folder

PURPOSE
- problem: orders taken by phone were forgotten or made twice
- who_it_serves: the two people at the counter
- my_goal: "never lose an order again"

WHAT EXISTS
- Order list | app | phone | working
- Customer list with phone numbers | data | phone | working
- Printed order form | document | paper folder | draft

WHAT IT CAN DO
- record an order with a due date
- remind the counter one day before

WHAT IT NEEDS
- a delivery driver | met? no | by what: nobody yet
- a second phone | met? yes | by what: bought in October

UNFINISHED
- weekly totals | a first page exists | stopped when the season got busy
  and nobody picked it up again

IDEAS NOT STARTED
- unknown

REUSABLE PARTS
- customer list with phone numbers | the Saturday baking class invites the same people
- the reminder one day before | every project here has dates and could use it

LINKS TO MY OTHER WORK
- Dar Bakery stock sheet | the same customers and items, kept twice
- the Saturday class | its students are bakery customers

RECURRING THEMES
- write it down once
- Arabic first

OPEN DECISIONS
- raise prices in Ramadan or not

WHAT YOU COULD NOT SEE
- the paper folder

Notes: the folder is in the shop.
